The project

One product category.
A whole library of visual content.

165 photos and 8 videos made for Agromir’s products and social media: product banners and promotional images, short video ads presenting the product range, and a 3D tire animation made in Blender and rendered with Eevee.

The work spans the full pipeline — concept, design, editing, motion and render — with one consistent visual system across every format.

Case study

A template that travels.

Video advertisement made from scratch to present product categories or services in a short, minimalist way. Using this template, four videos were created for four different companies, adapting the products, colours and branding for each one.

  1. 01Product silhouettes and a clean, neutral stage.
  2. 02A reusable motion system: cuts, reveals and type.
  3. 03Re-skinned per brand — four companies, one language.
SVPhotopeaTopaz Video EnhanceGigapixel AI
3D animation

A tire, dropped in slow motion.

A simple yet dynamic animation created in Blender, featuring a free 3D car tire model that falls from the top to the ground. The scene is rendered with Eevee for fast, high-quality visuals and enhanced with smooth camera movement, gradually closing in on the falling object to create a cinematic effect — perfect for a video advertisement.

  1. 01Model — free 3D tire asset, cleaned and staged.
  2. 02Animate — the drop, the bounce and the settle.
  3. 03Light — a single key light for hard, product-grade shadows.
  4. 04Render — Eevee, with a slow camera push-in.
